content.text: Home Guide to TPC Sawgrass Looking to book a tee time, perfect your technique, or plan a week-long golfing vacation?Here is everything you need to know about Florida’s most celebrated golf destination, TPC Sawgrass. TPC Sawgrass is the premiere spot for golfers visiting Northeast Florida. As guests, you will be invited to enjoy world-class courses, such as THE PLAYERS Stadium Course, award-winning restaurants, golf instruction, and more. 1. The Courses at TPC Sawgrass THE PLAYERS Stadium Course THE PLAYERS Stadium Course at TPC Sawgrass was designed by the acclaimed Pete Dye and built in 1982 to host THE PLAYERS Championship and become the competition's permanent home. As the first real "Stadium Course," the design was meant to improve the overall fan experience and lend no favor to any single kind of player or style of golf. Now an incredibly well-known course, praised for its balance and famous 17th hole, golfers from all over the world are welcome to play a match. Players will find a selection of short, medium, and long holes within the par-3, par-4, and par-5 categories. The course is also laid out so that no two consecutive holes play in the same direction. The 17th hole is one of the most honored with its signature island green capturing golf fans' attention worldwide. To learn more about visiting The Stadium course, click here. Dye’s Valley Course Adjacent to THE PLAYERS Stadium Course sits Dye’s Valley Course, another beautiful and challenging course designed by Pete Dye and Bobby Weed, built in 1987. Dye’s Valley has hosted several elite competitions and has been named one of the best golf courses in Florida. The course also features large greens, hundreds of trees, and water that runs through the hills and valleys, making your day on the course one to remember. To learn more about Dye's Valley, click here. 2. THE PLAYERS Championship Since its start in 1974, THE PLAYERS Championship has become one of the PGA Tour’s most popular events. Each year, the championship takes place on THE PLAYERS Stadium Course at TPC Sawgrass and brings thousands of golfers to the area to compete for one of the sport’s most sought-after titles. The week-long event is full of great matches, unforgettable events, and so much more. In 2025, THE PLAYERS Championship will be held March 10-15. Learn more about this years event here. 3. Golf Instruction TPC Sawgrass offers individual, group, and junior golf instruction through the PGA TOUR Performance Center. No matter what age or skill level you are, PGA Tour’s best players are ready to teach you it all. Enhance your full swing, short game, putting fundamentals, and more in a fun and competitive environment. Learn more about lessons and practice grounds here. 4. Where to Stay Sawgrass Marriott Golf Resort & Spa For guests who want more than a day to check out everything TPC Sawgrass has to offer, you’re in luck. TPC Sawgrass has partnered with Sawgrass Marriott Golf Resort & Spa to grant visitors the opportunity to stay where all the action happens. Named one of the Top 10 Best Golf Resorts in the World by Travel + Leisure Golf Magazine, this resort will provide you with full-service luxury and close access to the home of THE PLAYERS Championship. The resort also has many amenities, including incredible restaurants, fitness classes, a spa, and the exclusive Cabana Beach Club. A stay at Sawgrass Marriott Golf Resort & Spa is a vacation you will want to relive over and over again. Other Accommodations If you’re in Northeast Florida to explore more than TPC Sawgrass, the area is home to dozens of fantastic lodging options. From quiet beachfront hotels to luxury resorts, we’ve got it all. Find the right accommodations for your trip here. 5. Where to Eat TPC Sawgrass boasts some of the best dining in Northeast Florida with NINETEEN. NINETEEN is a unique restaurant that features a creative menu of freshly prepared American and Continental cuisine in a warm and inviting atmosphere. The menu changes seasonally in order to use only the freshest local fare, with options ranging from pan-roasted Florida grouper to falafel “mignon” and duck breast. NINETEEN also offers scenic views of the golf courses from its outdoor seating area. The restaurant is open to the public from breakfast to dinner each day of the week. Learn more here. 6. TPC Sawgrass Clubhouse This 77,000 square-foot clubhouse at TPC Sawgrass is open to the public and features a brilliant array of amenities. Between various dining options, an elegant banquet and meeting space, a beautiful gallery, and a top-notch golf shop, you'll find everything you need at the Clubhouse. Explore the incredible interior and enjoy PGA TOUR memorabilia on a guided or virtual tour of the building. For more information, click here.
